weeks.note: ADMIN FIRST: (1) book the certificato medico agonistico - Italy legally requires an ECG-based sports medical on the FITRI form, and without it you are not issued a race pack. Schedule by February. (2) Ramp-test FTP on the D100 this week and rescale the sweet-spot watts below - every bike split is a guess until you do. (3) RAMADAN starts about Mon 8 Feb and weeks 4-7 are in Abu Dhabi (22 Feb - 20 Mar); weeks 2-7 are built around both. Swim goes to FOUR short sessions - frequency beats volume, fatigue compromises motor learning. SESSION COUNT: 3 runs, 3-4 swims, 2 bikes, 1 legs, 6 days with Thursday off. That is ~9-10 h/week, which is INTERMEDIATE volume - MyProCoach's beginner 70.3 plan averages 7 h. If adherence slips, scale to the beginner shape rather than abandoning weeks. CUT ORDER: (1) Monday easy run, (2) the fourth swim, (3) Wednesday legs. Never cut the long ride, the long run, or below three swims.

An 8-week RCT in amateur runners raised lactate threshold velocity 5.9% with intrinsic foot work - but that was 30 min DAILY, so treat this as maintaining the tissue that failed on 7 Sep, not as a 5.9% gain.

BIKE ENDURANCE 60-75 min zone 2, HR under 145, steady. Aerobic volume with zero impact - the cheapest fitness available to you and it spares the shins.

weeks.note: RAMADAN STARTS about Mon 8 Feb (the moon sighting can move it a day). Weeks 2-6 follow the fast: hard and long sessions after iftar (light iftar, start 60-90 min later), short easy swims only in the last 1-2 hours before iftar, nothing hard and nothing over 60 min while fasted. Monday is a full rest day and the Friday zone-2 ride goes. HR runs higher at the same pace when you are dry - run by effort. First brick on Saturday: start the run within 5 minutes of racking the bike; the first 10 min feel wrong and it normalises by km 3. Get the bike fit done before Abu Dhabi: saddle height and cleat alignment are named ITBS contributors.

weeks.note: Buy the wetsuit now. Buy for BUOYANCY not speed - beginner suits run 5 mm through core/hips/legs, which directly fixes the sinking-legs problem. Wetsuits give the biggest gain to inefficient low-buoyancy swimmers, i.e. you: 5-11%, roughly 2-4 min over 1.9 km. Also buy neoprene BOOTIES - legal below 18.3 C and the water will be 15-17 C. ABU DHABI PREP: book Etihad if it is not done (a boxed bike travels in the checked-bag allowance - check the weight), get a bike box, and buy a spare Cube derailleur hanger to pack with it.

weeks.note: ABU DHABI from Mon 22 Feb - the flight day is a rest day. Iftar there is about 18:20, so night sessions start about 19:30. Al Wathba cycle track is floodlit and open all night; the sea is 21-23 C. Sea swims only on a lifeguarded beach, with a tow buoy, never alone. GUT TRAINING STARTS - 8-12 weeks out is the window. Target 60-70 g carb/h on the bike, NOT 90: measured exogenous glucose oxidation is 33 g/h under 70 kg vs 45 g/h above it. At 56 kg your ceiling is genuinely lower. Fuel every session over 75 min, +10-15 g/h every 1-2 weeks, and use the exact race products (Maurten, Precision PH 1000). In Ramadan the night rides carry it: drink with iftar, start 60-90 min later, fuel from the first 20 min.

weeks.note: TRANSITION PRACTICE this week. Measured Venice T1 median is 7:02 and T2 5:21; p90 is 11:05 and 7:08. A fumbled pair of transitions costs 8-12 minutes - more than most people gain from an entire block of bike work. Practise wetsuit removal until it is boring. Still Ramadan in Abu Dhabi: long and hard after iftar, the sea in daylight before it.

weeks.note: Last Abu Dhabi week and the first fully fed one - the big week. You fly home Sat 20 Mar, so the brick moves to Thursday. TARGET: 1900 m continuous. The cutoff needs only 3:41/100 m and ANY STROKE IS LEGAL - breaststroke the whole thing is permitted, and you may hold a buoy or kayak to rest provided you make no forward progress. Knowing that is what stops the panic that actually causes swim DNFs.

weeks.note: First week home: Amsterdam is about 15 C colder, so dress for the 100 km, and if Saturday's flight wrecked your sleep, ride it Monday. Biggest week. Bike pacing: target IF 0.68-0.72, cap the first 30 min 5 W BELOW target. Above 0.80 on a flat course is almost always a bike PB and a run blow-up. Also: this is a NON-DRAFTING race - 6 bike lengths clear, pass within 25 s, 5-minute penalty box. You ride in groups; this is a skill you do not have.

weeks.note: OPEN WATER STARTS - the single highest-consequence item in this plan. 90 of 120 sudden deaths in US triathlon occurred in the swim, and the mechanism is cold-water panic, not fitness. You should already have done 5-6 cold immersions over the winter; this is where it gets applied in a wetsuit.

weeks.note: Full dress rehearsal. Run plan is RUN/WALK from km 0, not as a fallback: 9 min run / 1 min walk blends to ~7:24/km and beats an even-paced blow-up by minutes per km. The course gives you 3 loops x 7.03 km with 9 aid stations - walk every one, 5-15 s, 3-5 good gulps.

weeks.note: RACE WEEK. Swim 1,898 m single counterclockwise loop from Lighthouse Beach, 4 turn buoys plus directional buoys every 100 m - unusually easy to sight. SELF-SEEDED ROLLING START, 3 athletes every 6 s: seed HONESTLY at 55-60 min, you will start ~08:15-08:30. Enter at the EDGE of your box. Water 15-17 C. Warm up in the water 06:30-07:00 then stay warm for 90 min. Swim the first 200 m deliberately too slowly. CUT-OFFS: swim 1:10 (absolute - zero finishers in 19,137 splits swam over 70:00), bike 5:30, overall 8:30. TRANSITION IS ~1 KM FROM THE SWIM START - two venues, walk it Friday. Target 6:15-7:15. Venice is a fast race: M25-29 median is 5:12, so you will be near the back of a quick field. That is fine.
